exact_semantics.SAT: F is SAT iff G_F has a matching saturating L
exact_semantics.UNSAT: F is UNSAT iff there exists S subseteq L with |N(S)|<|S|

recognizer_language.name: STANDARD_GRAPH_PHP_CNF
requirements: nonempty pairwise-disjoint all-positive pigeon clauses cover every variable exactly once
all remaining clauses are binary all-negative conflicts
negative-conflict connected components are cliques and contain at most one variable from each pigeon block
isolated variables are singleton right vertices
recognizer_language.complexity: polynomial graph scans and clique-component verification

certificate_paths.SAT: maximum matching M saturating L -> reconstruct one true edge per left vertex -> original CNF replay
certificate_paths.UNSAT: maximum-matching alternating forest -> deficient S and exact N(S) -> independently verify neighborhood and |N(S)|<|S|

algorithm.matching: Hopcroft-Karp or equivalent polynomial maximum bipartite matching
algorithm.asymptotic_ledger: T_recognize + T_construct + T_matching/Hall + T_reconstruct + T_verify <= poly(|F|)

hardness_baseline.name: HARD_UNSAT_EXPANDER
hardness_baseline.encoding: Ben-Sasson-Wigderson G-PHP standard graph pigeonhole CNF
hardness_baseline.experimental_expansion_certificate: (m,n,5,r,1)-expander with r=floor(n/4), checked exhaustively only by population generator
hardness_baseline.theorem: Ben-Sasson and Wigderson, Short Proofs Are Narrow—Resolution Made Simple, Theorem 4.15
hardness_baseline.existence_statement_used: for m=n+1 there exist (m,n,5,n/c,1)-expanders for a constant c>1
hardness_baseline.consequence: resolution width Omega(n) while original clause width is at most 5

HARD_UNSAT_EXPANDER.required: exact Hall/matching UNSAT plus width-lower-bound ledger

HALL_UNSAT_CONTROL.shape: m=n with a planted local Hall-deficient subset S of size 3 and |N(S)|=2
HALL_UNSAT_CONTROL.required: Hall quotient must find a valid deficient-set certificate

SAT_MATCHING_CONTROL.shape: m=n sparse bounded-degree graph with a planted saturating matching
SAT_MATCHING_CONTROL.required: matching certificate, assignment reconstruction, root CNF replay

population_generation_firewall.hard_expander_search: deterministic seeded benchmark construction before solver run
population_generation_firewall.expansion_audit: may enumerate left subsets up to frozen r solely to certify benchmark hardness fixture

substantive_pass_requires: one polynomially recognizable graph-PHP carrier language contains both SAT and UNSAT instances
COUNTING_BASELINE fails to decide HALL_UNSAT_CONTROL and SAT_MATCHING_CONTROL
HARD_UNSAT_EXPANDER has constant input clause width and theorem-backed resolution width Omega(n)
independent checker validates certificates against reconstructed graph and original CNF

scientific_firewall.claim_if_pass: separation for this polynomially recognizable graph-PHP structural subclass between growing resolution width and polynomial exact matching/Hall quotient decision
